subject.title: fix(auth): count token-type profiles in provider health status rollup

question: Should `models.authStatus` report effective token/setup-token health for OAuth-configured providers when no effective OAuth profile exists?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well-proven, but it changes a provider-health signal that existing dashboards or operator alerts may consume as an OAuth-only status.

options.title: Accept token fallback
options.body: Land the current OAuth-first, token-second rollup because it matches runtime usability after setup-token migration while preserving explicit auth-order exclusions.

options.title: Keep OAuth-only health
options.body: Pause or redesign the PR if maintainers want this gateway status to remain a strict OAuth-login health signal even for token-backed migrations.

recommendation.title: Accept token fallback
recommendation.body: Land the current OAuth-first, token-second rollup because it matches runtime usability after setup-token migration while preserving explicit auth-order exclusions.
